[[Harmony]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Divine Peacekeeper]]s and [[White Mantle Priest]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shadestone]], [[The Shadestone|the Shadestone (unique)]], and [[Illyana's Mirror]], except it appears to be a lighter color.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is a [[Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Olujime]].

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Divine Favor]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Jwup]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Serenity_Now|Serenity Now]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Divine Favor]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Divine Symbol]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription#Serenity_Now|Serenity Now]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
* [[Ajamahn's Artifact]], [[Byzzr's Benediction]], and [[Mallyx's Divinity]] have stats identical to this item.
* [[Imperial Dragon Focus]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].

==Trivia==
*There is a Divine Favor wand called [[Peace]] which makes the set name Peace and Harmony.
